bullets.text: Sports Development plans game-changing upgrades for three neighbourhood grounds including a running track at Shenoy Nagar, and the office should monitor these sports facility projects.
A central minister visited a private nylon fiber manufacturing unit at the Gummidipoondi SIPCOT industrial estate, and the office should track this industrial visit.
Malaimurasu took action regarding a gang allegedly stealing government lands involving the Tiruttani Sub-Registrar, and the office should watch this land fraud case.

stories.title: Three neighbourhood grounds to get game-changing upgrades
takeaways: Adyar will receive a new practice hockey court as part of neighbourhood sports upgrades in Chennai.
The initiative aims to improve local athletic facilities and encourage youth sports participation.
stories.snippet: Chennai: A six-lane running track at Shenoy Nagar, a practice hockey court at Adyar and a football practice facility at Mandavelipakkam are some sporting facilities planned at neighbourhood grounds by Sports Development…
